composition_summary: Drafted one unapproved pure-logic class22 component. The supplied contract is a raw validator: raw lag may be absent or any JSON value, and only exact integers -1..8 inclusive are accepted (bool/float/other rejected, no coercion). The helper receives the whole mapping so it can distinguish missing from explicit null, invokes it at module scope and assigns its returned object to result. No imports, I/O, host calls, Tool dispatch, submission, Q1/Q2 or activation occurred. The target typed-inputs interface requires selected-runner support; this is an unapproved draft only.
